quirks.description: the separator test reads the previous byte after it was uppercased, so a separator list with uppercase letters cascades: ucwords('aab', 'A') is 'AAB'

quirks.description: PHP 8.5.10 only treats an occurrence of a multi-byte (or cut) break as an existing break when it does not end the text (`<` where later releases use `<=`), and compares it with strncmp (up to a NUL)
quirks.case: string.json#wordwrap break at the end is not an existing break (8.5.10 quirk)
